subject: Pilot & Commit Incentive: LumiHealth Hosted API terms
messages:
From: Amir Farooq <amir.farooq@lumihealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@lumihealth.ai>, procurement@lumihealth.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing — pilot + commit incentives?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency and context handling looked promising for our triage assistant use case. Procurement asked me to get a concrete sense of economics so we can evaluate a pilot -> production path. A few specific asks: 

- Do you offer any pilot credits or trial credits that are separate from committed discounts?
- If we commit to a baseline monthly spend, what kind of per-token discount bands do you support (for hosted API usage)?
- Are there launch/marketing incentives (e.g., additional credits for joint launch or references)? Procurement wants numbers we can include in the POC budget.

Attached is our high-level usage profile and expected traffic spike patterns. We should be able to commit to an early production spend if the pilot goes well — target timeline is pilot in Sept, go-live in Q4.

Appreciate a short proposal we can share with procurement.

Best,
Amir
Product Lead, LumiHealth
[Attachment: LumiHealth_usage_profile_q3_2026.xlsx (xls)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Farooq <amir.farooq@lumihealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing — pilot + commit incentives?

Amir — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a short price schedule and a pilot-to-commit pathway we typically use for customers that look like LumiHealth. Key points up front: 

1) Pilot credits (90-day POC)
- We can provide $30,000 in platform credits valid for 90 days to cover the POC. Credits apply to hosted API per-token and embedding usage.
- No minimum commit required for the pilot itself; we ask for a short mutual action plan and a technical check-in at day 30 and day 75.

2) Commit tiers (monthly committed spend -> effective per-token markdown)
- Tier A: $25k/mo committed -> 10% discount off list per-token rates (list: $0.0008/1k-input-equivalent token unit)
- Tier B: $75k/mo committed -> 18% discount
- Tier C: $200k/mo committed -> 30% discount + reserved connection for predictable latency

Note: Our pricing model bills for input+output tokens; we can provide a usage projection template to translate your message/response size into tokens. The attached sheet shows example math using your traffic profile.

3) Launch incentive (conditional)
- If LumiHealth signs a 6-month committed agreement at Tier B or higher and publicly participates in a Redwood case study/launch announcement, we’ll provide an additional $40,000 in credits applied in first 60 days after go-live.
- Alternative: If public marketing is not permitted, we can convert that incentive into an equivalent one-time invoice credit on the first billing cycle (requires procurement acceptance in the MSA).

4) Other operational items
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for production endpoints on Dedicated/D1 pools; hosted API best-effort for free-tier pilot but we can provide higher SLAs under Dedicated or enterprise add-on.
- Security: SOC2 Type II evidence available; we’ll provide the security questionnaire set to procurement.

Next steps I recommend: 1) accept the pilot credit offer in email, 2) we share a short MSA + SOW redline for procurement, and 3) schedule the day-30 technical check-in. I’ve attached the price schedule spreadsheet.

SoojIN LEE
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: Redwood_LumiHealth_Price_Schedule_20260801.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Farooq <amir.farooq@lumihealth.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing — pilot + commit incentives?

Amir — jumping in on the incentive side. A couple of clarifications and an additional option you might find helpful for launch economics: 

- The per-token list rates in Soojin’s sheet assume standard FP16 execution on our hosted fleet. If you opt for quantized (int8) variants for bursty inference we can show a further ~12% unit-cost improvement; we’d want to validate quality on a short eval set.

- Launch accelerator option (one-time): for customers that need a big go-live uplift we can grant up to $75k additional credits provided: (a) you commit to a minimum of $150k/month for 3 months post-launch (b) Redwood is listed as a launch partner in a short co-announcement. We use the credits to help cover burst tokens and early research/feature tuning.

- Procurement / billing note: The pilot credits are issued as a contra credit on the first invoice period; they are not refundable and expire after 90 days. If you need an escrow or separate PO line, we can discuss invoicing the credits as a pre-paid token package.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement to walk the finance folks through the mechanics.

—Ben
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: internal SLA matrix (not attached to external mail)]

From: Amir Farooq <amir.farooq@lumihealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumihealth.ai, Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@lumihealth.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing — pilot + commit incentives?

Thanks Soojin, Ben — this is very helpful. Procurement has two quick asks before we circulate to legal: 

1) Can you put the pilot credit and the $40k/$75k launch incentives into a short commercial term sheet or exhibit we can attach to our PO? They want the trigger conditions and expiry in writing.
2) For the Tier B commitment language, procurement wants a sample monthly usage reconciliation example showing effective per-token price after credits and discounts for a typical month (we'll send our expected token profile if that's easier).

We’ll also attach a redline of your standard MSA — Danielle included the first pass (see attached). If you can turn around a short exhibit with the incentive language and the reconciliation example by early next week, we should be able to move this to legal review.

Amir
Product Lead, LumiHealth
[Attachment: Draft_MSA_redline_LumiHealth.docx (docx)]
